comparedSystems.description: DSH Compaction Weave 0.6.0 (Stage-1 local observation masking + Tier-4 salient prose + BM25F archive search + XML provenance isolation + recent-scoped coverage audit with global conflict redlines + redacted file reinjection)
DSH 0.2.2-rc.3 built-in BasicCompactionEngine + ToolResultPruner with full stock 65,536 headroomTokens (no artificial output cap)
billion-context@0.0.1328-master.ced22b1 (latest npm master build as of 2026-11-25) local ACP HTTP proxy with unified x-acp-session header, ccr enabled, and natural <acp-nudge> autonomous compression

fairnessAndAntiDistortionControls: dsh-basic mounted with stock headroomTokens (65,536) and CHAT_MAX_TOKENS=16384 to avoid artificial output truncation failures in w1.

billion-context@0.0.1328-master.ced22b1 mounted with a persistent header-injecting hop attaching x-acp-session per session across all turns and model switches plus ccr=true and autonomous <acp-nudge> handling.
Workloads use unique per-phase Node.js/SQL module implementations (100% distinct domain classes and functions, zero repetitive filler) and ambiguous fields explicitly permit null when unverified.
Models receive identical surface prompts, JSON schemas, and retry budgets via @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai over Magpie gateway.

models.note: Tested live on 2026-11-25 with active Gemini 4 Neon (group/gemini-4-neon), GPT-6.1 Sol (auto/gpt-6.1-sol), and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (deepseek/deepseek-flash); GLM excluded per benchmark configuration.

suiteB_fiveCycleCacheAndSpeed.description: Continuous 5-compaction engineering session (Cycles 1–5; Phases 1–5) measuring compactionSelfPct (cache hit on compaction call itself), R1 (one-turn prefix rebuild after compaction), R2–R6 steady-state KV cache recovery, totalCompactionWallMs, and endToEndWallMs on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and GPT-6.1 Sol across all 3 systems (6 trajectories, 30 compactions, 180 post-compaction replies).

suiteC_multiModelSwitching.description: 4-generation continuous model rotation (Gemini 4 Neon -> DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash -> GPT-6.1 Sol -> DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) with anti-trap probes and 2 cross-model hops per generation across all 3 systems.
